about: S-progress-days - Haladás > Napok (/progress/days), design round B frame lifeos/progress-days, and its undrawn states. The running dev backend has no migration 035 / GET /lifeos/stats (B-focus is not merged), so the read is answered by contract bodies typed by lib/lifeos-api.ts (B-focus Phase-6 block, LifeosStatsResponse) carrying the frame's figures (progress-days.part.js D14, WEEKS, HAB, KC); every other request replays the freeze of account M. Nothing is written. When the integrator records GET /lifeos/stats for a seeded account, these bodies become edit lists over the recording.

progress-days.title: Haladás > Napok — a keret (vasárnap, október 18.)
progress-days.why: the frame state: 490 this week, 14 day columns, 4 weeks, 4 habits, 13 kcal days. GET /lifeos/stats is answered by a contract body (the dev backend has no migration 035) -> matched-fixture at best

progress-days-failed.title: Haladás > Napok — a lekérés nem sikerült
progress-days-failed.why: a failed read: the header and switch, the danger line with "Újra" (GET /lifeos/stats answered 500)

progress-days-not-started.title: Haladás > Napok — nincs még időzóna
progress-days-not-started.why: LifeOS not started (no zone): the door row to "Nap és időzóna"

progress-door.title: Haladás — Test, a kapcsoló Napok cellájával
progress-door.why: the door: the Haladás page switch now has four cells (Test · Napok · Fotók · Megosztás), as the frame draws it

progress-door-open.title: Haladás — a Napok cella megnyitja a Napok oldalt
progress-door-open.why: the door works: Napok on the Haladás switch opens /progress/days (GET /lifeos/stats answered by the frame contract body)

progress-days-back.title: Haladás > Napok — a Fotók cella visszavisz a Fotók nézetre
progress-days-back.why: the way back: Fotók on the Napok switch returns to /progress with the Fotók view open (replace, no extra history step)
